headline: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.voteItem: Continue a consultant as a resource person for North Kīhei Mauka
meeting.summary: The committee reviewed the South Maui Community Plan update, heard testimony on the Wailea Golf plan, and recessed until October 6, 2026.
meeting.recap: The committee met to review Bill 108 (2026), the South Maui Community Plan update.[[0:06:17]] The main motion to recommend passing the bill on first reading carried over from earlier meetings.[[0:09:07]] Another testifier backed a Wailea Community Association compromise that keeps the Blue Course.[[0:20:01]] The golf representative and the community association president agreed to work together on traffic.[[3:49:46]] The chair said no vote on Section 3 is planned this week.[[3:53:35]] The committee recessed until 9 a.m. on October 6, 2026.[[5:06:05]]
decided: A consultant was kept on as a resource person for the North Kīhei Mauka section without objection.
Public testimony was closed and written testimony was accepted into the record.
meeting.next: The chair asked to draft a letter to the Finance Department about the roughly $20 million subdivision bond. The chair said she hopes to go through the whole plan later this week.

moments.q: "Absolutely. Okay. There you have it. You heard it here first."

boards.name: Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

issues.oneLine: A draft policy says North Kīhei Mauka homes may be built for Maui residents with a range of types and prices.
issues.brief: The representative said they have committed to doing "30% in excess of the requirement.".[[#1]] The representative said 225 acres could hold 600 to 1,000 homes, but no number is set.[[#2]]
